build._comment: Nixpacks runs `npm ci` itself during install; repeating it here fails with EBUSY because node_modules/.cache is a mounted build cache. Render (render.yaml) does need the explicit npm ci — its build command is the whole build. Migrations are NOT here: Railway's build sandbox cannot open the Neon WebSocket (ETIMEDOUT), though the runtime network can. They run in preDeployCommand instead, which still completes before any container serves traffic.

preDeployCommand: npm run db:migrate:prod && npm run db:seed:prod
